sources.title: What the Nyquist Criterion Means to Your Sampled Data System Design
sources.author: Walt Kester / Analog Devices
sources.read_locator: printed pp. 1, 4–6: sampling interval, Nyquist criterion, sinusoidal alias fs-fa, baseband antialiasing filters

excerpts.quote: Notice that the pattern of the actual samples produces an aliased sinewave at a lower frequency equal to fs – fa.
The Nyquist bandwidth is defined to be the frequency spectrum from dc to fs/2.
The antialiasing filter passes signals from dc to fa while attenuating signals above fa.

sources.inspection_note: 直接下載並以 pdftotext -layout 閱讀原廠 PDF 的取樣與濾波段落；只用於均勻取樣與基頻音訊的機制，未把原廠電路性能數據引為本課實測。

sources.title: scipy.signal.resample_poly
sources.read_locator: opening method definition and Notes paragraph beginning The first sample

excerpts.quote: The signal x is upsampled by the factor up, a zero-phase low-pass FIR filter is applied, and then it is downsampled by the factor down.

sources.inspection_note: 讀取官方版本化原頁，確認 low-pass 後 downsample、rate 乘 up/down 與 sample spacing 乘 down/up。僅為重取樣原理佐證；未聲稱本專案呼叫 SciPy。
